title: inventory.stock.updated — Payload Schema
description: Incremental update emitted by erp.inventory when the observable stock state of a product at a location changes. Published atomically with every event that modifies aggregate_available: physical receipts, adjustments, reservation creation, rejection, expiry, and release. Consumers must update their local availability index on receipt.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core. References catalog.product.changed / catalog.product.snapshot.

location_id.description: Warehouse or storage location identifier. Single-warehouse tenants use the sentinel value 'warehouse-main'. Per ADR-004.

stock_sequence.description: Monotonically increasing version counter per (product_id, location_id) pair. Consumers must discard any message where stock_sequence is less than or equal to the last processed sequence for this pair. Primary idempotency mechanism.

quantity_on_hand.description: Physical units confirmed in inventory (received, counted, or adjusted). Does not account for reservations or operational blocks.

quantity_reserved.description: Units with an active reservation (created but not yet confirmed, rejected, expired, or released). Managed exclusively by erp.inventory in response to order lifecycle events.

quantity_blocked.description: Units blocked from sale for operational reasons: quality hold, pending inspection, damage, return processing. Set by warehouse operations, not by Commerce.

quantity_adjustment.description: Signed correction applied to reconcile physical count against system record. May be negative. Examples: shrinkage correction, count recount. Applied by ERP before publishing aggregate_available.

aggregate_available.description: Units that Commerce may sell right now. Invariant: aggregate_available = quantity_on_hand - quantity_reserved - quantity_blocked + quantity_adjustment. Computed by erp.inventory and published as a first-class field. Consumers must NOT recompute this value from the other fields — erp.inventory may apply internal adjustments not exposed in this schema.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the stock change was committed in ERP Core. Generated by erp.inventory, not by the consumer.
